content:
Track: Data Wrangling with Python
    - Lesson 1: Reading and Writing CSV Files in Python
    - Lesson 2: Manipulating Pandas DataFrames
    - Lesson 3: Handling Missing Values in Datasets
    - Lesson 4: Merging and Joining DataFrames
    - Lesson 5: Grouping and Aggregating Data using Pandas
    - Lesson 6: Cleaning and Preprocessing Textual Data with NLTK
    - Lesson 7: Handling Imbalanced Datasets
    - Lesson 8: Advanced Data Transformations

  Track: Introduction to SQL
    - Lesson 1: Understanding SQL Basics
    - Lesson 2: Creating and Modifying Tables
    - Lesson 3: Basic CRUD Operations with SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE Statements
    - Lesson 4: JOIN Clauses (INNER, OUTER, LEFT, RIGHT)
    - Lesson 5: Subqueries and Correlated Subqueries
    - Lesson 6: Aggregations and GROUP BY Clauses
    - Lesson 7: Indexing and Optimizing SQL Queries
    - Lesson 8: Advanced SQL Techniques (Stored Procedures, Views)

  Track: Data Visualization with Python (Part 1)
    - Lesson 1: Intro to Matplotlib and Line Charts
    - Lesson 2: Bar and Histogram Charts with Matplotlib
    - Lesson 3: Scatter Plots, Heatmaps, and Contour Maps
    - Lesson 4: Boxplots, Violin Plots, and Empirical Density Estimation
    - Lesson 5: Introduction to Seaborn Library
    - Lesson 6: Statistical Plots with Seaborn (Regression, Scatterplot Matrix)
    - Lesson 7: Time Series Data Visualization
    - Lesson 8: Building Interactive Dashboards using Bokeh and Plotly

  Track: Data Visualization with Python (Part 2)
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Data Storytelling
    - Lesson 2: Advanced Seaborn Plots (Facet Grids, Swarm Plots)
    - Lesson 3: Customizing and Styling Matplotlib and Seaborn Plots
    - Lesson 4: Mapping with Folium and Leaflet
    - Lesson 5: Creating Dashboards for Sharing Insights
    - Lesson 6: Optimizing Visualizations for Communication
    - Lesson 7: Building an Effective Data Presentation
    - Lesson 8: Case Study: Applying Data Visualization Skills to a Real-World Dataset

  Track: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
    - Lesson 1: EDA Basics and Workflow
    - Lesson 2: Descriptive Statistics and Measures of Central Tendency
    - Lesson 3: Measures of Dispersion, Skewness, and Kurtosis
    - Lesson 4: Correlation Analysis with Pearson's Correlation Coefficient
    - Lesson 5: Time Series Analysis using Moving Averages, Autocorrelations, and Seasonality
    - Lesson 6: Clustering and Segmenting Data
    - Lesson 7: Anomaly Detection and Outlier Analysis
    - Lesson 8: EDA for Categorical Variables (Chi-Square Test, Fisher's Exact Test)

  Track: Machine Learning Fundamentals
    - Lesson 1: Supervised vs. Unsupervised Learning
    - Lesson 2: Introduction to Regression and Classification Algorithms
    - Lesson 3: Overfitting and Underfitting, Cross-Validation, and Regularization
    - Lesson 4: Feature Scaling, Normalization, and Standardization
    - Lesson 5: Evaluating Model Performance (Metrics, Confusion Matrix)
    - Lesson 6: Ensemble Learning Methods (Bagging, Boosting)
    - Lesson 7: Dimensionality Reduction Techniques (PCA, t-SNE)
    - Lesson 8: Building and Evaluating a Machine Learning Model
